sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते ।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥ १२-१॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsate
ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ 12-1
translation: Those devotees who, eversteadfast, thus worship you, and also those who worship the imperishable, the unmanifested — which of them are better versed in YOGA?
